get.description: List the organization's bank accounts, archived ones included.

post.description: Register a PEN bank account. Admins only; idempotent on the client-generated id.

put.description: Change the bank, alias or last four digits of an active account. Admins only.

post.description: Archive an account so it takes no new imports. Admins only.

get.description:
The demo's third month, to import by hand: the bank statement (starting with the last
rows already imported, as bank exports overlap) or the receivables. Only inside a demo
(403 `not_a_demo`).

post.description:
Continue the demo as its user with another role, in a new session.

Only inside a live demo organization and between its demo users (403 `not_a_demo`).

Queue the matching engine over the free credits of one account and month.

Analysts only; `period` is the first day of the month. Idempotent on the
client-generated id. 409 `closed_period` for a closed month and `run_in_progress` while
another run of the same account and month is queued or running.

get.description: An engine run; `finished_at` and `proposals_count` are set when it ends.
List the organization's import profiles, archived ones included.

post.description: Create an import profile. Admins only; idempotent on the client-generated id.

put.description: Rename an active profile or change its file layout. Admins only.

post.description: Archive a profile so it is no longer offered for imports. Admins only.

get.description: Example profiles to copy. Bank layouts must be checked against a real file.
Imports from newest to oldest, by keyset cursor (no total, no jump to the end).

post.description:
Upload a bank statement or a receivables file (CSV or XLSX, up to 5 MB) and queue
its preview.

Analysts only; idempotent on the client-generated id. `duplicate_of` warns about a
confirmed file of the same kind with the same content (in the same account for a
statement).

get.description: An import with its row counts by status.

post.description:
Queue the confirmation of a preview. Analysts only.

Repeating the request while the job is pending returns the same job.
Discard a preview without saving any movement. Analysts only.

get.description: A page of preview rows of one status, by row number (keyset pagination).

post.description:
Void a confirmed import. Analysts only.

A statement voids its movements; refused if any is in a closed period or in an active
match. A receivables import cancels the receivables it created; refused if any is in a
proposed or confirmed match.

get.description: How many free credits and proposed, confirmed and approved matches a month has.
Credits of the month in no active match, by date (keyset pagination).
The months with live credits in an account, newest first, and whether each is closed.

post.description:
Invite someone by email. The token is returned only when the invitation is created.

Idempotent on the client-generated id.
Accept an invitation addressed to the signed-in user's email.
Revoke a pending invitation. Admins only.

get.description: Status and progress of a background job of the current organization.

post.description: End the current session.

get.description:
Matches of the month in one status, in the order they were created (engine proposals
come out rule by rule). The amount filters apply to the sum of the credits.
A match with its credits, receivables, applied amounts, difference and decisions.
Name, difference tolerance and detraction rates used by the matching engine.

put.description:
Change the organization settings. Admins only.

Amounts are in cents and rates in basis points.

get.description:
Receivables by due date, oldest first, by keyset cursor (no total, no jump to the end).

`cancelled=true` lists only cancelled receivables; otherwise only live ones. `document`
finds one document number in any accepted spelling (`F1-123` finds `F001-00000123`);
422 `invalid_document` if it is not a document number.

post.description:
Cancel a receivable with a reason. Analysts only; repeating it changes nothing.

Refused if the receivable is in a proposed or confirmed match; what is already approved
stays applied.

get.description: Describe the current session and the organizations of its user.

post.description: Switch the session to another organization of the user, rotating the session.

get.description: List the active members and pending invitations. Admins only.

post.description: Remove a member, drop their roles and end their sessions in this organization.

put.description: Replace the roles of a member. The organization always keeps an admin.

get.description: Report that the API process is up.

post.description:
Create a demo organization with fictional data and sign in as its analyst.

At most 5 per IP and 300 in total per day (429 `demo_limit`).

Create an account for the invited email, accept the invitation and sign in.

Any reason the invitation cannot be used, including an email that already has an
account, gives the same answer.
Start a session with email and password.
Create an organization and its first admin. Idempotent on the client-generated id.
